blocks.text: Inherited from Old East Slavic помьнити, from Proto-Slavic *pomьněti or *pomьniti, from Proto-Balto-Slavic *minḗˀtei, from Proto-Indo-European *mn-eh₁- (present stem *mn-eye-), from the root *men- (“to think, mind”). Cognates include Old Church Slavonic помьнѣти, Polish pomnieć, Slovene pomniti.
